rules: HOST existing Endless Museum; Day Zero supplies room/view/XR hands.
Tutorial teaches selected constructions; final.md reflects; exhibits may belong to neither.
Print complete minimal learner code once; carry actual predecessor; declare support; test exact code and meaningful variations.
Preserve author choices and reasons. A capsule is navigation, not implementation permission.
Separate proposal, source inspection, runtime evidence, headset experience and human learning.
Keep originals. A changed hash asks for reinspection; it does not prove a claim false.
limits: The route is a memory address system, not a literal architectural floor plan.
Six opening capsules were compared with selected current tutorial passages. Other halls expose current subject labels only.
Images are dated museum photographs. They are retrieval cues, not current runtime evidence.
This prototype does not run DeepSeek-OCR or measure model tokens, reasoning retention, headset behaviour or human learning.
A future AI must load the packet and fetch its sources; the atlas does not change model weights or provide automatic permanent memory.

Point_Zero.bring: Prepared running museum; counter already encountered.
Point_Zero.change: Minimal counter.gd creates Label3D in _ready; _process reads Engine frames. Move reading to _ready for once-only comparison.
Point_Zero.keep: Declare reference ≠ create label ≠ attach label. Engine frame count ≠ elapsed seconds.
Point_Zero.carry: Initialization and repeated execution → Point One.
Point_Zero.do_not_infer: Do not supply the lesson label secretly or rebuild the museum. Passing code is not evidence of learning.
Point_Zero.question: What does arriving in an already-running world ask us to borrow?

Point_One.change: point.gd creates StaticBody3D, SphereMesh and SphereShape3D; named centre/radius drive construction.
Point_One.keep: Position, visible surface and physical boundary are separate. Shared radius keeps the two boundaries aligned.
Point_One.do_not_infer: The supplied room does not supply the learner's point. The initial point is not yet pickable.
Point_One.question: What has a visible surface added to a mathematical point?

Point_Coordinates.bring: Point One construction: centre, radius, mesh and collider; configured XR hands/library supplied.
Point_Coordinates.change: Replace body with XRToolsPickable; set pickup/release; create readout. Compare global_position with PointStudy.to_local.
Point_Coordinates.keep: Continue the point; name both frames. LOCAL and WORLD can differ without moving the point in the world.
Point_Coordinates.do_not_infer: Distance is the next hall's subject. Construction continuity does not mean automatic runtime object transport.
Point_Coordinates.question: Does the name belong to the position, sphere or permission to hold it?

Point_Lines.change: Extract PointBody class; instantiate endpoints. displacement = B - A; length gives distance. LineSkin draws span. Compare parallel, plus and X.
Point_Lines.keep: Displacement has direction; length does not. Endpoint positions use one unit-scale study frame.
Point_Lines.carry: Unchanged PointBody and LineSkin → Trace; replace live pair with recorded neighbours.
Point_Lines.do_not_infer: A live segment retains no journey. The line's social associations belong to final.md, not extra implementation obligations.
Point_Lines.question: What does measurement keep, and when does a line become an instruction?

Point_Trace.bring: PointBody + LineSkin from Lines; unit-scale PointStudy.
Point_Trace.change: Array[Vector3] stores local metre positions; append/index; distance IF >= 0.05; neighbour FOR draws segments. Intentional release saves via supplied TraceArchive.
Point_Trace.keep: Sampled positions + existing segment sculpture; order retained; no timestamps. Pause need not append. Cleanup must not overwrite an intentional save.
Point_Trace.carry: user://ada_student_trace.scn in same project → Grid. A later valid release replaces the saved work.
Point_Trace.do_not_infer: This is not every hand sample or a timed replay. October 4 session-only evidence cannot describe the later saved tutorial handoff.
Point_Trace.question: What of a gesture remains when the record has no time?

Point_Line_Grid.bring: Load Trace's positions and existing segments from user://ada_student_trace.scn in the same project.
Point_Line_Grid.change: Keep pink original; duplicate nodes, meshes and materials for green copy. Round XYZ / grid_step into integer addresses; place at address * grid_step.
Point_Line_Grid.keep: Original positions and archive unchanged. Display offsets do not enter quantization. No save means ask for Trace, not invent a drawing.
Point_Line_Grid.carry: Preserved source positions → Triangle; record and representation remain distinct.
Point_Line_Grid.do_not_infer: Rounding loses distinctions and cannot recover an arbitrary original. The museum exhibit and reduced learner study need not use identical frames or spacing.
Point_Line_Grid.question: What distinctions disappear when several positions share an address?
